column1: # TipBot TipSheet template. Lines starting with # are notes and are ignored. One row per leg.
# kind: SINGLE or MULTI. A MULTI is 2 or more rows with the same group label (for example M1).
# game: the match (for example Sydney Swans v Fremantle). player: the player's name.
# stat: for example Disposals / Goals / Marks / Tackles / Kicks / Handballs / Hitouts / Clearances / Fantasy Points.
# line: a number (for example 24.5). side: Over or Under (O and U also work).
# odds: decimal odds above 1 (for example 1.85). units: stake in units above 0 (for example 1).
# MULTI rows: put the tip's total odds and units on every row of the group.
